email.body1:
Nick, saw IntelAgree landed Casey's and partnered with onPhase off the back of Saige Assist.

Wins like those open more in-market accounts than an SDR team can follow up on, and slow follow-up is where good replies die. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so your reps spend time in conversations, not in research and CRM: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to your top three target accounts. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through them?
email.body2:
Nick, quick follow-up for IntelAgree.

Most SDR teams lose ground on response speed and follow-up volume, not list quality. The fix is rarely more reps, it's getting every account touched and re-touched fast enough to catch buyers while they're in market.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I'd change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50-70 percent.
email.body3:
Nick, last bit of proof for IntelAgree.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how IntelAgree's reply rate likely compares to similar startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Nick, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If speeding up follow-up and ramp without adding SDRs isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Running a development team is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your SDR motion? I'll tailor it to IntelAgree either way.
